measurement: MP-REL3/AX native inspection with a fresh release build, and why interaction is blocked
inspection_worked: A release build from a fresh target directory creates a window named 'COS Desktop' (class Zed::Window). UI Automation reports 48 descendants whose automation ids are listed in automation-id-inventory.txt - TitleBar, SystemMenuBar, Item 1, Minimize, Maximize, Close, task-search (ControlType.Edit), task-row-fixture:task/Task-184 (ControlType.ListItem) and the candidate buttons - and Orca's computer-use surface reports the same window as a 46-line tree in orca-accessibility-tree.txt.
interaction_blocked: Keyboard input cannot be delivered. UI Automation's SetForegroundWindow returns false even after AttachThreadInput, the foreground window belongs to another process, SendKeys reaches nothing, and the same shortcut posted as window messages leaves the descendant count at 48 with no panel ids. Orca independently refuses the chord with window_not_focused, and the same refusal with --restore-window, in orca-hotkey-refusal.json and orca-hotkey-restore-window-refusal.json.
consequence: Everything that needs keyboard input stays NOT_OBSERVED: opening the diagnostics panel with the shortcut, Tab and Shift+Tab traversal, the save dialog and its overwrite confirmation. The panel ids (diagnostic-readonly, support-preview-readonly, support-export-button, support-export-status) could not be listed because the panel never opened.
